text.S1: Once upon a time there were four little Rabbits, and their names were— Flopsy, Mopsy, Cotton-tail, and Peter.
text.T1: Pali akantunse, kwali tu Kalulu tune, elyo amashiina yabo yali- Flopsy, Mopsy, Umucila- wa Cotton na Petulo.
text.T2: Pali akantunse, kwali tu Kalulu utunoono tune, elyo amashiina yatuko yali- Flopsy, Mopsy, Umucila- wa Cotton na Petulo.

text.S1: They lived with their Mother in a sand-bank, underneath the root of a very big fir-tree.
text.T1: Baleikala na ba nyina mu nchende ya muchanga, munshi ya mushila wa cimuti ca Fir icikalamba.
text.T2: Twaleikala na nyina mu ncende ya mucanga, mwisamba lya mushila wa cimuti ca Fir icikalamba.

text.S1: 'Now my dears,' said old Mrs. Rabbit one morning, 'you may go into the fields or down the lane, but don't go into Mr. McGregor's garden: your Father had an accident there; he was put in a pie by Mrs. McGregor.'
text.T1: 'Lelo mwebatemwikwa bandi', fyasosele Bamuka Kalulu ulucelo luumo, 'Kuti mwaaya mu mpanga nangula panshi pa museebo, lelo tekwesha ukuya mwibala lya ba McGregor: ba Wiso balikwete ubusanso uko; ba babikile mu fyaakulya ba muka McGregor.
text.T2: 'Lelo mwebatemwikwa bandi', efyasosele Bamuka Kalulu ulucelo lumo, 'Kuti mwaaya mu mpanga nangula mwisamba lya pa museebo, lelo tekwesha ukuya mwibala lya ba McGregor: ba Wiso balikwete ubusanso uko; ba babikile mu kati ka mukaate wakulya kuli ba muka McGregor.

text.S1: 'Now run along, and don't get into mischief. I am going out.'
text.T1: 'Nomba butuuka, elyo wiponena mu fyakucita-cita. Ndefuumapo'.
text.T2: 'Nomba butuka, elyo wiponena mu fibifi. Ndefuumapo'.

text.S1: Then old Mrs. Rabbit took a basket and her umbrella, and went through the wood to the baker's. She bought a loaf of brown bread and five currant buns.
text.T1: Elyo bamuka ba Kalulu basendele umuseke uutaali na umwamfuli, elyo ba piita mu mpanga ukuya ku ba panga umukate. Bashitile umukate uwafiita ne fibanshi fisaano.
text.T2: Elyo bamuka Kalulu basendele umuseke uutaali na umwamfuli, elyo ba piita mu mpanga ukuya ku ba panga umukate. Ashitile umukate uwakashikila ne mikate yabulungana isaano.

text.S1: Flopsy, Mopsy, and Cotton-tail, who were good little bunnies, went down the lane to gather blackberries
text.T1: Flopsy, Mopsy na Umuciila wa-Cotton, abali tu Kalulu utunono utwamaano, twaile kunshi mu musebo mu kuswa amalubeni.
text.T2: Flopsy, Mopsy na Umuciila wa-Cotton, utwaali tu Kalulu utunono utwamaano, twaile kunshi mu musebo mu kusaba amalubeni.

text.S1: But Peter, who was very naughty, ran straight away to Mr. McGregor's garden, and squeezed under the gate!
text.T1: Lelo Petulo, ushaile umfwa icipesha amaano, abutukiile kwibala lya Ba McGregor, no kuipatika panshi pa geti!
text.T2: Lelo Petulo, uusha leumfwa icipesha amaano, abutukiile kwibala lya Ba McGregor, no kuipatika panshi ya ciseko cacingilila ulubansa!

text.S1: First he ate some lettuces and some French beans; and then he ate some radishes;
text.T1: Icantanshi, alile umusaalu na cilemba ya bena French; elyo alya ifyamu mushili ifya mulopa-mulopa.
text.T2: Icantanshi, alile umusaalu na cilemba ya bena French; elyo alya ifyamu mushili ifya kashika.

text.S1: And then, feeling rather sick, he went to look for some parsley.
text.T1: Elyo, aumfwa ukulwala, atampile ukuya fwaaya umuti wa mumushili.
text.T2: Elyo aumfwa ukulwala, atampile ukuya fwaaya umuti ku miti yalelema.

text.S1: But round the end of a cucumber frame, whom should he meet but Mr. McGregor!
text.T1: Lelo, mukushinguluka ifisaabo fyaabo, akumeenya Ba McGregor beene!
text.T2: Lelo, mukushingauka mumbali pampela ya cibimbi, akumeenya Ba McGregor beene!

text.S1: Mr. McGregor was on his hands and knees planting out young cabbages, but he jumped up and ran after Peter, waving a rake and calling out, 'Stop thief!'
text.T1: Ba McGregor bali ba minwe na makuufi balebyaala tu cabiki, lelo balitoloka nokupepeka Petulo, bale mupepeka neceela no kupuunda, 'Imanina Kabwalala!'
text.T2: Ba McGregor bali ba minwe na makuufi balebyaala tu cabiki, lelo balitoloka nokupepeka Petulo, bale mupepeka neceela no kupuunda, 'Imanina Kabwalala!'

text.S1: Peter was most dreadfully frightened; he rushed all over the garden, for he had forgotten the way back to the gate. He lost one of his shoes among the cabbages, and the other shoe amongst the potatoes.
text.T1: Petulo atinine iciibi na umwenso wa mwikete; abutwike mwibala moonse, bantu alilaaba nenshila yakubwelela ku geti. Alufishe ulusapato lelo muli cabiki, nalumbi ulusapato mu fyumbu fya cisungu.
text.T2: Petulo atinine iciibi na umwenso wa mwikete; abutwike mwibala moonse, pantu alilaabile nenshila yakubwelela ku ciseko cacingila ulubansa. Alufishe ulusapato lelo muli kabiki, nalumbi ulusapato mu fyumbu.

text.S1: After losing them, he ran on four legs and went faster, so that I think he might have got away altogether if he had not unfortunately run into a gooseberry net, and got caught by the large buttons on his jacket. It was a blue jacket with brass buttons, quite new.
text.T1: Kunuma kwaku shiluufya, abuutwike pa maakasa yane no ku butukisha, ukutiila abutukiishe abalufye mukutontonkanya kwakwe elyo awiile mwisumbu, elyo aikatwa ku ma batani yali pe jeketi.Lyali li jeketi lya makumbi- makumbi na ba batani ya fyeela, ilipya.
text.T2: Panuma yaku shilufya, abuutwike pa maakasa yane no ku butukisha, ukutiila abutukiishe abalufye mukutontonkanya kwakwe elyo awiile mwisumbu, elyo aikatwa ku ma batani yali pe jeketi.Lyali li jeketi lya makumbi- makumbi nama batani ya ceela, ilipya.

text.S1: Peter gave himself up for lost, and shed big tears; but his sobs were overheard by some friendly sparrows, who flew to him in great excitement, and implored him to exert himself.
text.T1: Petulo ali ibwelamo pantu aliluba nganshi, elyo alila ifilamba ifikalamba; lelo ukulilakwakwe kwaumfwike ku fyoni ifyaba bwiino, iya pupwike kuli ena mukwangufyanya, no ku mu patikisha ukwesha.
text.T2: Petulo ali ibwelamo pantu aliluba nganshi, elyo alila ifilamba ifiingi; lelo ukulilakwakwe kwaumfwike ku fyoni ifyaba bwiino, iya pupwike kuli ena mukwangufyanya, no ku mu patikisha ukwesha.

text.S1: Mr. McGregor came up with a sieve, which he intended to pop upon the top of Peter; but Peter wriggled out just in time, leaving his jacket behind him.
text.T1: Ba McGregor bapangile isumbu ya fyeela iya ku mukupikila na Petulo; lelo Petulo akwanishe ukufuumamo panshita fye, asha ne jeketi kunuma.
text.T2: Ba McGregor bapangile isumbu lya fyeela iya ku mukupikila na Petulo; lelo Petulo akwanishe ukufuumamo panshita fye, asha ne jeketi kunuma.

text.S1: And rushed into the tool-shed, and jumped into a can. It would have been a beautiful thing to hide in, if it had not had so much water in it.
text.T1: Elyo abutukiila mu ng'anda basungiila ifyeela fya ku bomfya, lokutolokela muka kopo. Nga cali icisuuma nganshi ukufisamamo, nga tacakwete ameenshi ayengi nganshi mo.
text.T2: Elyo abutukila mu ng'anda basungiila ifyeela fya ku bomfya, nokutolokela mu cikopo. Nga cali icisuuma nganshi ukufisamamo, nga tacakwete ameenshi ayengi nganshi.

text.S1: Mr. McGregor was quite sure that Peter was somewhere in the tool-shed, perhaps hidden underneath a flower-pot. He began to turn them over carefully, looking under each. Presently Peter sneezed—'Kertyschoo!' Mr. McGregor was after him in no time.
text.T1: Ba McGregor bali ishibe ukutiila Petulo ali mu ng'anda Ba sungila ifyeela, limbi na fisama munshi mwakubiika iluba. Atampile ukuyakupukula kamo-kamo, nokulolesha munshi mwa tonse. Pali iyo nshita Petulo atesemuuna!' Ba McGregor bamukonkele mukampampa.
text.T2: Ba McGregor bali ishibe ukutiila Petulo ali mu ng'anda Ba sungila ifyeela,limbi na fisama munshi ya cikopo camaluba. Atampile ukuyakupukula kamo-kamo, nokulolesha munshi mwa tonse. Pali iyo nshita Petulo atesemuuna!' Ba McGregor bamukonkele mukampampa.

text.S1: And tried to put his foot upon Peter, who jumped out of a window, upsetting three plants. The window was too small for Mr. McGregor, and he was tired of running after Peter. He went back to his work.
text.T1: Nokwesha ukutiila ulukaasa pali Petulo uwaishile toloka pa nsolokoto, nokuceena amabuula yatatu. Insolokoto yacepesha kuli Ba McGregor, elyo bali naka ukupepeka Petulo. Baisa bwelelafye ku ncito yabo.
text.T2: Nokwesha ukutiila ulukaasa pali Petulo uwaishile toloka pa nsolokoto, nokuceena amabuula yatatu. Insolokoto yacepesha kuli Ba McGregor, elyo bali naka ukupepeka Petulo. Baisa bwelelafye ku ncito yabo.

text.S1: Peter sat down to rest; he was out of breath and trembling with fright, and he had not the least idea which way to go. Also, he was very damp with sitting in that can. After a time, he began to wander about, going lippity—lippity—not very fast, and looking all round.
text.T1: Petulo aikele panshi ukutiila atuushe; munshi napwa umupu elyo na tutuma ku mwenso, elyo taishibe inshila ya ku ya. Elyo ninshi nabomba mukwikala mucikopo ca munshi. Lilya papitako inshita, atampile ukupitana, aleya lipiti-lipiti- tale endesha iyoo, aleloleshafye koonse.
text.T2: Petulo aikele panshi ukutiila atuushe, alipwilwa umuupu elyo aletutuma ku mwenso, elyo taishibe inshila ya ku ya. Ilyo ninshi nabomba mukwikala mucikopo ca munshi. Lilya papitako akashita, atampile ukupitana, aleya lipiti-lipiti tale endesha iyoo, aleloleshafye koonse-koonse.

text.S1: He found a door in a wall; but it was locked, and there was no room for a fat little rabbit to squeeze underneath. An old mouse was running in and out over the stone doorstep, carrying peas and beans to her family in the wood. Peter asked her the way to the gate, but she had such a large pea in her mouth that she could not answer. She only shook her head at him. Peter began to cry.
text.T1: Asangile icibi mu cibumba; lelo cali ica isalika, elyo takwali napakuipatika panshi. Kateeka umukote alebutukiila mukati elyo panse pamulu yalibwe lya ku nyantapo, aleimya tu cilemba twa cisungu na cilemba iine kuli ba lupwa bakwe mu mpanga. Petulo amwipwishe inshila ya ku fika ku geti, lelo akwete cilemba iikulu nganshi mu kaanwa afililwe ukwasuuka. Alipukunya fye umutwe kuli ena. Petulo atampile ukuliila.
text.T2: Asangile icibi mu cibumba, lelo cali ica isalika, elyo takwali napakuipatika panshi. Kateeka umukote alebutukiila mukati elyo panse pamulu yalibwe lya ku nyantapo, aleimya tu cilemba twa cisungu na cilemba iine kuli ba lupwa bakwe mu mpanga. Petulo amwipwishe inshila ya ku fika ku geti, lelo akwete cilemba iikulu nganshi mu kaanwa afililwe ukwasuuka. Alipukunya fye umutwe kuli ena. Petulo atampile ukuliila.

text.S1: Then he tried to find his way straight across the garden, but he became more and more puzzled. Presently, he came to a pond where Mr. McGregor filled his water-cans. A white cat was staring at some gold-fish. She sat very, very still, but now and then the tip of her tail twitched as if it were alive. Peter thought it best to go away without speaking to her; he had heard about cats from his cousin, little Benjamin Bunny.
text.T1: Elyo aeseshe ukusanga inshila ukufuuma pe bala,lelo ale fulunganinakofye. Apapene, afiika pa menshi ayanono epo Ba McGregor bale isushisha ifitini fya menshi fyaabo. Pushi wa buuta aleloleshya isabi ya bengeshima. Aikele tondolo, talesakanya nokusakanya, lelo munshita umucila wa le sela kwati uli no mweo. Petulo atontonkenye ukutiila kuti caaba ica yaana ukuseelapo ukwabuula ukusosha pushi; ali umfwile pe lyashi lya ba pushi ku mu fyaala wakwe, Kalulu umunono Benjamin.
text.T2: Elyo aeseshe ukusanga inshila ukufuuma pe bala,lelo ale fulunganinakofye. Apapene, afiika pa menshi ayanono epo Ba McGregor bale isushisha ifitini fya menshi fyaabo. Pushi wa buuta aleloleshya isabi ya bengeshima. Aikele tondolo, talesakanya nokusakanya, lelo munshita umucila waleseela kwati uli no mweo. Petulo atontonkenye ukutiila kuti caaba ica yaana ukuseelapo ukwabuula ukusosha pushi; ali umfwile pe lyashi lya ba pushi ku mu fyaala wakwe, Kalulu umunono Benjamin.

text.S1: He went back towards the tool-shed, but suddenly, quite close to him, he heard the noise of a hoe—scr-r-ritch, scratch, scratch, scritch. Peter scuttered underneath the bushes. But presently, as nothing happened, he came out, and climbed upon a wheelbarrow and peeped over. The first thing he saw was Mr. McGregor hoeing onions. His back was turned towards Peter, and beyond him was the gate!
text.T1: Abwelele uko ba McGregor basunga ifyeela, lelo ica mupamba, mupepi nankwe, aumfwile icongo ca lukasu- mpo, mpo, mpo, mpo. Petulo abuutuka munshi ya mpanga. Lelo pali inonshita, tapali ifyacitike, alifuuma, nokukweela icibaala na ukulengela. Icantanshi, amwene no Ba McGregor bale komaula muli anyanse. Inkumba yali kuli Petulo, elyo ukupitilila pali ena epali umwinshi.
text.T2: Abwelele uko ba McGregor basunga ifyeela, lelo ica mupamba, mupepi nankwe, aumfwile icongo ca lukasu- mpo, mpo, mpo, mpo. Petulo abuutuka munshi ya mpanga. Lelo pali inonshita, tapali ifyacitike, alifuuma, nokukweela icibaala na ukulengela. Icantanshi, amwene no Ba McGregor bale komaula muli anyanse. Inkumba yali kuli Petulo, elyo ukupitilila pali ena epali umwinshi.

text.S1: Peter got down very quietly off the wheelbarrow; and started run- ning as fast as he could go, along a straight walk behind some black- currant bushes. Mr. McGregor caught sight of him at the corner, but Peter did not care. He slipped underneath the gate, and was safe at last in the wood outside the garden.
text.T1: Petulo afuminepo bwangu pacibala; elyo abutwike mukwangufyanya, ukupitila ku musalu ku mpanga. Ba McGregor ba mu mweene ninshi alekoneka, lelo Petulo tasakamene, apitile panshi wa geti, aishiba no kutiila apusuuka mu mpanga kuunse ye baala.
text.T2: Petulo afuminepo umutalalila paliwilubala, elyo abutwike mukwangufyanya, ukupitila ku musalu ku mpanga. Ba McGregor ba mu mweene ninshi alekoneka, lelo Petulo tasakamene, apitile panshi wa ciseko ca lubansa, aishiba no kutiila apusuuka mu mpanga kuunse ye baala.

text.S1: Mr. McGregor hung up the little jacket and the shoes for a scare-crow to frighten the blackbirds.
text.T1: Ba McGregor ba samike ijeketi lyakwe iinono ne nsapato ku cidoli cakutinishako ifyoni fya fiita.
text.T2: Ba McGregor ba samike Akali jeketi kakwe ne nsapato ku cidoli cakutinishako ifyoni fya fiita.

text.S1: Peter never stopped running or looked behind him till he got home to the big fir-tree.
text.T1: Petulo talekele ukubutuuka nangula ukulolesha Kunuma mpanga fye afika ku ng'anda ku cimuti ca fir icikalamba.
text.T2: Petulo talekele ukubutuuka nangula ukulolesha kunuma mpaka afika ku ng'anda ku cimuti ca mfungo icikalamba.

text.S1: He was so tired that he flopped down upon the nice soft sand on the floor of the rabbit-hole and shut his eyes. His mother was busy cooking; she wondered what he had done with his clothes. It was the second little jacket and pair of shoes that Peter had lost in a fort-night!
text.T1: Ali nakile icakutila afikile fye aiposa na pa muchanga uusuma uwanaka panshi pa cipunda ca ba Kalulu no kwisala amenso. Nyina aleipika; alepapafye efyo acitile ne fyakufwala fyakwe. Efya bubili- insapato ne jeketi efyo Petulo alufishe mu milungu ibili!
text.T2: Ali nakile icakutila afikile fye aiposa na pa mucanga uusuma uwanaka panshi pa bwendo bwaba Kalulu no kwisala amenso. Nyina aleipika; alepapafye efyo acitile ne fyakufwala fyakwe. Efya bubili- insapato ne jeketi efyo Petulo alufishe mu milungu ibili!

text.S1: I am sorry to say that Peter was not very well during the evening.
text.T1: Ndi wabulanda ukusosa ukutiila Petulo tasendeme bwino mu cungulo.
text.T2: Ndi wabulanda ukusosa ukutiila Petulo tasendeme bwino mu cungulo.

text.S1: His mother put him to bed, and made some camomile tea; and she gave a dose of it to Peter! 'One table-spoonful to be taken at bed-time.'
text.T1: Ba nyina bali mulalika, ba mu pangila nensukale ya mabula; elyo ba mu nwisha Petulo! 'Imo supuni ikalamba iya kuunwa pa nshita ya ku sendama'.
text.T2: Ba nyina bali mulalika, ba mu pangila nensukale ya mabula; elyo ba mu nwisha Petulo! 'Imo supuni iikalamba iya kuunwa pa nshita ya ku sendama'.

text.S1: But Flopsy, Mopsy, and Cotton-tail had bread and milk and blackberries for supper.
text.T1: Lelo Flopsy, Mopsy na Umucila wa Cotton ba nwine umukaka no mukate na malubeni ku cakulya ca mucungulo.
text.T2: Lelo Flopsy, Mopsy na Umucila wa Cotton ba nwine umukaka no mukate na malubeni ku cakulya ca mucungulo.

text.S1: THE END
text.T1: ILYASHI LYA PELA
text.T2: ILYASHI LYA PELA
